changelog.name: v2.0.0
changelog.body:
Hello everyone! After months of hard work we have finally decided to release v2.0.0 as a stable release.
This update includes a massive UI and UX overhaul, a bunch of new features and more.

### What's New?

#### Introducing the Scripting Engine
This update includes a fully-fledged JavaScript Engine based on [rhino](https://github.com/mozilla/rhino), enabling users to write custom scripts. Refer to our [documentation repository](https://github.com/SnapEnhance/docs) for details.

### Features
This update adds a whole bunch of new features to SnapEnhance (too many to list here), see the [README](https://github.com/rhunk/SnapEnhance?tab=readme-ov-file#features) or the [wiki](https://github.com/rhunk/SnapEnhance/wiki/Features-Explained) for a full feature list. Some highlights include:
* The ability to see if a Snap has been sent exclusively to you.
* Fully encrypted End-to-End Encryption between SnapEnhance users.
* Preventing forced logouts due to logging in on another device.
* The ability to edit already sent messages.
* A built-in Session Manager and Account Switcher.

### Bug Fixes
We have fixed numerous bugs that were present in v1 and unintentionally introduced new ones. Help us find them by creating an [issue](https://github.com/rhunk/SnapEnhance/issues).

*Note: Please include all the information you have when creating issues, low effort issues will be marked as invalid and closed.*

## Compatibility
Tested on Snapchat version **12.80.1.0**.

- SHA256 (armv8): ``1d735f2a4115fc2b656012dcf512dcf498ded719fa80ab890fd04e2a2198d98b``
- SHA256 (armv7): ``9cd4c2c744edc6ab1b625b72b781277f657722d5bcaf7ad453e84c8856cd378d``
- SHA256 (universal): ``a8dd499b4ec83eb2e77e26d6d1dac86b98ec5e111dc7afdd8302660c8f2a7e90``

## New Contributors
* @ReSo7200 made their first contribution in https://github.com/rhunk/SnapEnhance/pull/250
* @CanerKaraca23 made their first contribution in https://github.com/rhunk/SnapEnhance/pull/479
* @weblate made their first contribution in https://github.com/rhunk/SnapEnhance/pull/529
* @bocajthomas made their first contribution in https://github.com/rhunk/SnapEnhance/pull/733

Thanks to everyone who contributed via Weblate!

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/rhunk/SnapEnhance/compare/v1.2.6...v2.0.0
